# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.17.1

## What's new

- **Expedition, undo and reset:** Alt+Shift+Q takes back the latest reward chosen in the current map. "Reset this map" forgets all of that map's choices so you can choose again from the start: a button in Tracker → Expedition, or a shortcut you can set in Settings (no key by default). In the Tracker, a single choice can be deleted from any map.

## Fixes

- **Loot filter:** exceptional Jade Tiaras are priced and shown again. The base is below level 65, but its exceptional copies sell, so it now joins the few low bases that are still scanned.

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
